name: 1.20 - Trails & Tales
highlights: Archaeology: suspicious sand and gravel, brushes, pottery sherds and decorated pots
Cherry grove biome and the full pink cherry wood set
Camel and sniffer mobs (sniffer hatches from eggs found via archaeology and digs up ancient seeds)
Armor trims and smithing templates - netherite upgrading now requires a template from bastions
Hanging signs, chiseled bookshelves, bamboo wood set, calibrated sculk sensors
Trail ruins structure
whyItMatters: Netherite got harder: you now need a netherite upgrade template (guaranteed in bastion treasure rooms) plus 7 diamonds to duplicate each one
Cherry wood and armor trims are pure cosmetics that changed how bases look
Archaeology added the first new Overworld loot-hunt mechanic in years
keywords: 1.20 trails and tales update archaeology cherry blossom camel sniffer armor trims

name: 1.21 - Tricky Trials
highlights: Trial chambers: procedurally generated combat dungeons with trial spawners that scale to your party
The breeze and its wind charges, plus the bogged (poison-arrow swamp skeleton)
The mace: crafted from a heavy core (ominous vaults) and a breeze rod, smash attacks scale with fall height
Vaults and ominous vaults with per-player loot, trial and ominous trial keys
4 new status effects brewed into potions: Infested, Oozing, Weaving and Wind Charged
Crafter block (auto-crafting), copper and tuff block families expanded, 3 new music discs (Creator, Precipice, Creator Music Box), 20 new paintings
whyItMatters: First renewable dungeon: trial chambers can be re-farmed every 30 minutes
The mace one-shots almost anything with enough fall distance - Wind Burst makes it a movement weapon
Bad Omen became an item (ominous bottles), letting you choose when raids and ominous trials start
keywords: 1.21 tricky trials update trial chambers breeze mace vault bogged crafter

name: 1.21.x Game Drops (2024-2025)
highlights: Bundles of Bravery (1.21.2/1.21.3, Oct 2024): bundles for everyone, hardcore mode on Bedrock
The Garden Awakens (1.21.4, Dec 2024): pale garden biome, the creaking (only moves when unseen, killed via its creaking heart block), pale oak set, resin and eyeblossoms
Spring to Life (1.21.5, Mar 2025): warm and cold variants of pigs, cows and chickens, firefly bushes, leaf litter, wildflowers, falling leaves, cactus flowers
Chase the Skies (1.21.6, June 2025): the happy ghast - rehydrate a dried ghast, raise the ghastling and fly with up to 4 players on a harness; player locator bar; Tears music disc
The Copper Age (1.21.9, fall 2025): the copper golem returns (sorts items between copper chests and regular chests), copper chests, copper tools, weapons and armor, shelves
whyItMatters: Mojang moved to small named 'drops' instead of one huge annual update - content now arrives all year
The happy ghast is the first rideable flying mount in vanilla survival
Copper finally has a real use chain: tools, armor, chests and a mob that sorts your storage
keywords: game drops garden awakens pale garden creaking spring to life chase the skies happy ghast copper age copper golem

name: 26.1 - Tiny Takeover
highlights: First drop under the new year-based version numbering (Java 26.1, Bedrock 26.10)
Baby mobs and rabbits got real models instead of shrunken adults - each with new sounds
Name tags are now craftable
Golden dandelion: feed it to a baby mob to keep it young forever (feed again to undo)
whyItMatters: Version numbers changed: after 1.21.x, Mojang switched to year-based 26.x versions for Java, with Bedrock on its own numbering (26.10, 26.30...)
Pet collectors can finally freeze baby animals - expect baby-mob zoos everywhere
keywords: 26.1 tiny takeover baby mobs golden dandelion name tags craftable new version numbering

name: 26.2 - Chaos Cubed
highlights: Sulfur caves: a new cave biome home to sulfur cubes
New sulfur and cinnabar block families with their variants
Java 26.2, Bedrock 26.30 (announced at Minecraft LIVE, March 2026)
whyItMatters: A brand-new cave biome to explore and build with
Sulfur and cinnabar expand the underground building palette
keywords: 26.2 chaos cubed sulfur caves sulfur cube cinnabar blocks

name: 26.3 - Wilderness Bound
highlights: Dappled forest biome near cold regions, with poplar trees in red, orange and yellow leaf variants plus fallen poplar trunks
Abandoned camp structures with their own explorer maps to find them
Straw beds, cushions, shelf mushrooms and red shrubs
Wool stairs/slabs and concrete stairs/slabs for every color
Spectator mode players can now use portals; Realms invite codes
Java 26.3, Bedrock 26.50
whyItMatters: The camping fantasy finally vanilla: camps, straw beds and cushions
Wool and concrete stairs/slabs were two of the most-requested builder blocks ever
Poplar is the first wood type with three leaf colors on one tree family
keywords: 26.3 wilderness bound dappled forest poplar abandoned camp straw bed cushions wool stairs concrete slabs
